newsitem.title: CANADA: Hydro-Quebec buys 40 pct of Novarco Inc.
newsitem.headline: Hydro-Quebec buys 40 pct of Novarco Inc.

text.p: Provincially owned electricity utility Hydro-Quebec said on Monday that it had acquired a 40 percent interest in Novarco Inc from Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec in a C$309-million transaction.
Hydro-Quebec said it acquired the stake from the Caisse, the province's pension fund manager, after SOQUIP, a Quebec energy agency, sold its shares in Novarco to the Caisse.
Hydro-Quebec said its stake includes 32 percent of Norarco's common shares and an option to buy an eight percent block of shares held by brokerage firm Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion Inc.
After the transactions, the shareholder composition of Novarco is as follows: Caisse de depot, 36 percent; Gaz de France, 24 percent; and Hydro-Quebec, 40 percent.
Novarco is a private holding company that controls Gaz Metropolitain, which distributes most of the natural gas sold in the province of Quebec.

Hydro-Quebec said the electical utility and Gaz Metropolitain will continue as separate corporate entities. They will, however, combine their efforts to increase their penetration of the North American energy market.
Jean Abiteboul, chairman of Novergaz, speaking on behalf of Gaz de France, said he was pleased to see the new partnership at Novarco.
